watchForm.providersHint: Up to five Bifrost provider ids, for example anthropic, openai
watchForm.maxUsdPerDayHint: It must cover the budget for each new model times the most per day

problems.needProviders: Name at least one provider to watch.
problems.tooManyProviders: A watch can follow at most five providers.
problems.needEvaluation: Pick the saved evaluation to run on each new model.
problems.needCurrent: Pick the setup of that evaluation that is your current model.
problems.needBudget: Give a budget above 0 USD for each new model.
problems.needDaily: Give a spending limit per day above 0 USD.
problems.dailyTooLow: The spending limit per day must cover the budget for each new model times the most per day.
